id.description: Integration id, unique across integrations; also the provider id.

deepLink.description: Optional link to the API's own UI, shown on the integration's tile.

url.description: The http(s) URL polled; it may not carry user:password@.

headers.description: Literal, non-secret request headers. A name naming a credential (auth, cookie, token, secret, key, pass, session, credential) is refused: credentials come from credentialEnv.

body.description: A JSON request body, sent with POST only.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

auth.description: How the credentialEnv value is sent; without it the value is the raw Authorization header.

scheme.description: bearer: Authorization: Bearer <value>; basic: the value is user:password, sent base64-encoded; header: the value in the named header.

header.description: The header carrying the credential, for scheme header.

timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a poll may take, redirects and body included; default 5000.

ttlMs.description: Milliseconds the data stays fresh; default the poll interval.

maxBytes.description: The largest response body accepted, in bytes; default 1048576 (1 MiB).
